review_object: pairwise event-relation pre-review of 31 D-dev pilot sources
model_id_source: CODEBUDDY_CURRENT_MODEL_ID environment variable of the running session
model_id_note: Provider-side immutable snapshot id (date/commit suffix) was not exposed; the value above is the routing identifier reported by the runtime. No suffix was invented.
input_hash_check: sources.jsonl and pairs.jsonl match manifest.json output_sha256; REVIEW_GUIDE_ZH.md matches guide_sha256; all three upstream source files match manifest.json input_sha256; validation.json reports 31 sources / 465 pairs and was re-checked for uniqueness.

provenance.evidence_source: verbatim fragments of the 31 supplied texts only; empty when the text could not support the judgement (none required)

conventions.relation: same_event / related_event / shared_entity_or_topic / unrelated / uncertain, per REVIEW_GUIDE_ZH.md
conventions.unrelated_default: any pair without a documented shared event, actor, place or substantive topic is labelled unrelated; genre membership (sports, tech sector, deal news) is explicitly not treated as a topic relation
conventions.evidence: left_evidence / right_evidence are verbatim substrings of the respective supplied text; ellipses are not inserted and truncated tails are never completed
conventions.non_transitivity: relations are pairwise only; no transitive closure was applied

interruption: None. Processing was batched (all 465 pairs written in one pass after reading all 31 texts); no pair was skipped and no row was carried over from an earlier review.
limitations: Only these 31 D-dev texts; unrelated means no relation visible in the supplied fragments, not proven semantic independence.
Very short excerpts (120-360 chars) and four truncated documents limit time/actor resolution; no original full text or publication dates were consulted.
Single-model pre-review; no second reviewer and no human adjudication, so no decision here is human gold.
Genre-level similarity (sports, tech, deal news) is deliberately not counted as shared topic; a project-level convention change would move some pairs.
No membership labels, attack outcomes, A-cal/V/T or defense experiments were read or run; nothing here supports claims about attack success or defense effectiveness.
